step1_analysis.description: A reconfigurable switched-capacitor DC-DC converter that uses a network of switches and flying capacitors to step down or step up the input voltage. The provided netlist is a simplified, ideal-switch extraction of the converter's core switching network.

paper_reference.title: A 93% Efficiency Reconfigurable Switched-Capacitor DC-DC Converter Using On-Chip Ferroelectric Capacitors

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard SKY130 MOM/MIM capacitors have higher bottom-plate parasitic capacitance (typically 5-10%) compared to the custom high-density ferroelectric capacitors used in the paper. This increases switching losses and reduces the maximum achievable efficiency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Average of V(VOUT) in steady state
sky130_expected.reasoning: For a 2:1 conversion ratio from a 1.8V supply, the ideal output is 0.9V. Load current and switch resistance will cause some voltage droop.

output_ripple.description: Peak-to-peak voltage ripple at the output

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly listed, but implied by 10nF load cap

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on load current, switching frequency (8.2MHz), and the load capacitance (10nF).

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure output voltage, ripple, and power conversion efficiency of the SC converter. The original netlist syntax is adapted to use ngspice voltage-controlled switches.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switched-Capacitor DC-DC Converter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param VDD=1.8
.param FSW=8.2Meg
.param TPER={1/FSW}
.param THALF={TPER/2 - 1n}

* Supply and Clocks
VVIN VIN 0 DC {VDD}
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(0 {VDD} 0 1n 1n {THALF} {TPER})
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(0 {VDD} {TPER/2} 1n 1n {THALF} {TPER})

* Ground reference for N0
R_N0 N0 0 1m

* Load
Rload VOUT 0 100

* --- DUT ---
* Original extracted netlist had syntax issues for ngspice switches and missing cap values:
* S1 (VOUT VIN) switch_ideal
* S2 (VIN VIN) switch_ideal
* S3 (N2 VIN) switch_ideal
* S4 (N0 VOUT) switch_ideal
* C2 N0 VOUT
* C1 N2 VIN
* S5 (N0 N0) switch_ideal
* S6 (VOUT N2) switch_ideal

* Fixed DUT for simulation (added control nodes and capacitor values):
S1 VOUT VIN phi1 0 switch_ideal
S2 VIN VIN phi2 0 switch_ideal
S3 N2 VIN phi1 0 switch_ideal
S4 N0 VOUT phi2 0 switch_ideal
C2 N0 VOUT 10n
C1 N2 VIN 1n
S5 N0 N0 phi1 0 switch_ideal
S6 VOUT N2 phi2 0 switch_ideal

.model switch_ideal SW(Ron=1 Roff=1Meg Vt=0.9)

* Analysis
.tran 1n 5u

.control
run

* Measure output voltage and ripple
meas tran vout_avg avg v(VOUT) from=3u to=5u
meas tran vout_max max v(VOUT) from=3u to=5u
meas tran vout_min min v(VOUT) from=3u to=5u
let vout_ripple = vout_max - vout_min
print vout_avg vout_ripple

* Measure efficiency
meas tran pin_avg avg i(VVIN) from=3u to=5u
let pin = -pin_avg * 1.8
let pout = (vout_avg * vout_avg) / 100
let eff = (pout / pin) * 100
print pin pout eff

quit
.endc
